1gtbeep: Nobody saw Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-S1, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep is number 612. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-S1 changed before the cheering ended. Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep shouldered another load.
Bastian Enjoyer and Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep and Albin "Saint" Aruuki split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
At R-S1 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep won the bet. Henrik Davidsonmars was grazed.
Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep wrote a song about the Chalk Pits. Otto Dalev wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-S1. Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep fired at the last man to run. Hugo Luissantos was badly wounded.
Dorian wrote a letter for Oskar Keremuraz's mother, because Oskar could not find the words. Oskar signed it.
andyincorporated: After 9 days of war, R-S16 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor.

Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Isidor "Saint" Imerv was badly wounded. A bullet went through Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor's sleeve at R-S16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Arno Coopergfulto of the Concord (@coopergfulton). Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor is whole again, or near enough for the line. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor answered to number 614. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle.
A loose thread in Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home.
Rain blew in under the dugout door. Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor moved his boots out of the wet, then realized they were already inside.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Florian Marks, badly wounded. Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Officers came to inspect R-S16. Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Wendel and Ulrich Olotro disagreed about the best way to make tea. The tea was ruined, and so was the afternoon.
angel._.mihai: Matthias Mihai reached S-F10 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Matthias Mihai, volunteer number 50, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.

Anselm Tom cut Matthias Mihai's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. After the loss of Verdel Ridge, Matthias Mihai helped stack spare sandbags at S-F10. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
On sentry duty Matthias Mihai watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
A shell knocked in the parapet at S-F10. Matthias Mihai was dug out of the sandbags bruised, coughing, and furious.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Matthias Mihai tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F10 is up. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Matthias Mihai shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Matthias Mihai was on light duty: bandaged, bored and in charge of the kettle.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Matthias Mihai is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Matthias Mihai changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. A letter from home reached Matthias Mihai before dusk. Matthias Mihai read it twice and slept a little easier.

Matthias Mihai fired at a movement across the wire at S-F10. The man went down: Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri, grazed. A letter from home reached Matthias Mihai before dusk. Matthias Mihai read it twice and slept a little easier.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Matthias Mihai dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Otto Valiantlyval coming out. It was over in seconds. (@valiantlyvaliancy) The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Matthias Mihai did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home reached Matthias Mihai before dusk. Matthias Mihai read it twice and slept a little easier.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Matthias Mihai received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. A letter from home reached Matthias Mihai before dusk. Matthias Mihai read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Matthias Mihai watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Matthias Mihai across the shin at S-F10. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Florian Hsrr of the Concord (@jere.hsrr). A letter from home reached Matthias Mihai before dusk. Matthias Mihai read it twice and slept a little easier.

Matthias Mihai rejoined the squad at S-F10. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. A letter from home reached Matthias Mihai before dusk. Matthias Mihai read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wiring party. Matthias Mihai held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F10, and everyone came back. A letter from home reached Matthias Mihai before dusk. Matthias Mihai read it twice and slept a little easier.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Matthias Mihai fired, and Walter "Hollow" Leuttne was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Matthias Mihai before dusk. Matthias Mihai read it twice and slept a little easier.

Matthias Mihai crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich reached for a rifle. Matthias Mihai was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@coreyjmcmichael) Matthias Mihai threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks was down and screaming for a medic. (@csllgaks) The raid was over in minutes. On the way back a machine gun swept no man's land, and Matthias Mihai did not reach the parapet.
Wendel "Mud" Mihai had heard about Matthias Mihai's courage. At S-F10, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A man asked Wendel "Mud" Mihai to describe Ashford Vale without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. A letter reached Wendel "Mud" Mihai in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.

On dawn watch at S-F10, Wendel fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato, now grazed. Wendel unfolded the letter carefully. A dried leaf fell out, and Wendel put it in a pocket without a word.
averelle_3d: Nils Averelle told the sergeant he was a tram conductor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
Nils Averelle is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
The transfer made Nils Averelle a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Nils Averelle agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Nils Averelle watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A single shot from across the wire hit Nils Averelle in the thigh at R-F11. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony (@hay_ant_hud).

Nils Averelle wrote half a letter home from bed, then tore it up. It said he was fine. It was not a convincing lie. A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier.

There was never a bed for Nils Averelle, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F11 on his own feet. A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F11. Nils Averelle has learned to walk bent double.

The artist tried again while Nils Averelle read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion. A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier.

A clear shot from R-F11. Nils Averelle grazed Felix Lowelleast and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Nils Averelle fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier.

Nils Averelle was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F11. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Konrad Sebs of the Hegemony (@_sebs.c_). A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier.

Nils Averelle returned to R-F11 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. Blackwater Canal is lost. Nils Averelle heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier.

Nils Averelle reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F11 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Hugo Blasian of the Hegemony (@blasian117). Across from R-F11, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Nils Averelle saw it. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini was grazed. A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F11 with the rations. Nils Averelle ate while listening to the revised orders.

The wound on Nils Averelle's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. Nils Averelle left the work of a machine gunner to become a stretcher bearer. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Nils Averelle made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier.
Nils Averelle lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.

Nils Averelle and Henrik Sleepyman sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. A letter from home reached Nils Averelle before dusk. Nils Averelle read it twice and slept a little easier.

Nils Averelle mended the hole in Emil "Brick" Xavidonegan's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Brick says the patch is stronger than the trousers. The letter for Nils Averelle was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Nils Averelle liked the crossed-out parts best.

The trench wall shook against Nils Averelle's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit. The runner said a letter for Nils Averelle had come up with the ammunition. Nils Averelle went to get it before the ammunition.

Gustav "Doc" Dawgdawghuuu of the Hegemony shouted a joke across the wire at Calvary Farm. Nils of the Concord laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it. The letter for Nils was mostly about the weather at home. Nils read that part twice too.
comrade_crackhead: Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead arrived with the Day 6 draft, carrying a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead held the mirror while Leopold "Whistle" Leh shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead's transfer to the role of sapper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Marek "Button" Gergely kept the tin. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead. Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead repaired a collapsed wall of the trench at S-S6 with sandbags, boards and language not fit for letters home. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead. Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The raid was quick, the way back was not. Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead free. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead wrote to a wife and a daughter he has never met that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead. Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead is number 448. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
The stretcher Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead is back at S-S6, and someone else is lying in that dent now.
Rumour reached S-S6 that the war would be over by spring. Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead has heard it before. So has everyone.
Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead and Casimir Chypotatoes divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint.
Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead snores. Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril does not. Whistle now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
A bullet hit the sandbag next to Zeno's ear at S-S6 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Quentin Vicious of the Hegemony (@darth._.vicious).
easton.stoll: Silas Stoll reported to N-F20 with a stub of a pencil sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Silas Stoll tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. Silas Stoll got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.

Silas Stoll did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Silas Stoll fired back. Clement "Mud" Sporkus was badly wounded. A letter for Silas Stoll came with a pressed flower inside. Silas Stoll showed the flower to nobody.

Silas had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Benedikt Edwinni was badly wounded. Silas had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Edmund "Brick" Thatbadduckk, grazed. A short letter reached Silas: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Silas read the part about the dog twice.
fluffybaldy: Viktor Fluffybaldy came up the line with a tin whistle and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Viktor Fluffybaldy found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
Viktor Fluffybaldy ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.

Viktor Fluffybaldy fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Florian Human was grazed. The gun crews at N-F4 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Marek "Saint" Aoidragon was grazed. A letter from home reached Viktor Fluffybaldy before dusk. Viktor Fluffybaldy read it twice and slept a little easier.

The Hegemony raiders came over at N-F4 in the middle of the night. Viktor Fluffybaldy met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad of the Hegemony (@nalabrad).

A letter came with Albin Fluffybaldy: "I am Viktor Fluffybaldy's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. After what happened at Sorrow Copse, Albin Fluffybaldy asked to serve as a runner. Nobody argued.

Officers came to inspect N-F4. Albin Fluffybaldy polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is. A letter came for Albin Fluffybaldy with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Albin Fluffybaldy pinned it to the dugout wall.

Albin drew a map of Wendel Shitter's hometown from Wendel's stories. Wendel says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. Albin got a letter and a pair of mittens. The mittens were too big. Albin wore them anyway.
ghai.gpt: Ulrich Gpt introduced himself as a bookbinder from Brennmoor. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Ulrich Gpt's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.
The snipers took Ulrich Gpt in on a wet morning in R-F14. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.
Ulrich Gpt had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel "Mole" Freddie crossed it, Ulrich Gpt fired. Wendel "Mole" Freddie was badly wounded.

The cook borrowed Ulrich Gpt's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory. Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Ulrich Gpt could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Ulrich Gpt lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.

A single shot from across the wire hit Ulrich Gpt in the thigh at R-F14. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Clement Jewnipers of the Hegemony (@jewnipers). A letter from home reached Ulrich Gpt before dusk. Ulrich Gpt read it twice and slept a little easier.

Ulrich Gpt drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. A letter from home reached Ulrich Gpt before dusk. Ulrich Gpt read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Ulrich Gpt stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

The medics would not give up on Ulrich Gpt. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-F14 today. A letter from home reached Ulrich Gpt before dusk. Ulrich Gpt read it twice and slept a little easier.

A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Ulrich Gpt. The men named it the Judge and said it had chosen him. A letter from home reached Ulrich Gpt before dusk. Ulrich Gpt read it twice and slept a little easier. Ulrich Gpt's transfer to the role of signaller was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Ulrich Gpt saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. A letter from home reached Ulrich Gpt before dusk. Ulrich Gpt read it twice and slept a little easier.
Ulrich Gpt tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Brennmoor. Every version sounded like the ration bell.

The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-F14. Ulrich Gpt has learned to walk bent double. A letter from home reached Ulrich Gpt before dusk. Ulrich Gpt read it twice and slept a little easier.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Ulrich Gpt went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-F14, Ulrich Gpt listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A newspaper reached Ulrich Gpt with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. A letter from home reached Ulrich Gpt before dusk. Ulrich Gpt read it twice and slept a little easier.
A flare caught Ulrich Gpt halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Ulrich Gpt. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. A letter from home reached Ulrich Gpt before dusk. Ulrich Gpt read it twice and slept a little easier. Ulrich Gpt became a machine gunner today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

A round went through the rim of Ulrich Gpt's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Florian Ebrrrvole of the Hegemony (@ebrrrvole). Ulrich Gpt had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Gustav Ethanlam was badly wounded.
Ulrich Gpt rejoined the squad at R-F14. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

Ulrich Gpt was found at the bottom of the trench at R-F14, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf). Ulrich Gpt was hit at R-F14 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf).
Lucien Gpt arrived carrying the family name of Ulrich Gpt. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
A bullet nicked Lucien's boot at R-F14. The heel is gone. So is a little skin. Shot by Yann Zannwaffen of the Hegemony (@zannwaffen_).
keithforbes65s: Edmund Keithforbes unpacked a child's drawing of a horse at Q-F2. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Edmund Keithforbes looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Edmund Keithforbes lent Otto Mihai a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into Q-F2. Edmund Keithforbes has learned to walk bent double.
Edmund Keithforbes mended the hole in Otto Wahoocardboa's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Otto says the patch is stronger than the trousers.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Edmund Keithforbes in the open at Q-F2. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Felix Volta of the Hegemony (@esteban.volta). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Edmund Keithforbes fell at Q-F2 and never moved again. Shot by Felix Volta of the Hegemony (@esteban.volta).
Tobias Keithforbes had heard about Edmund Keithforbes's courage. At Q-F2, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A bullet struck Tobias Keithforbes below the ribs at Q-F2. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Felix Volta of the Hegemony (@esteban.volta). A single shot at Q-F2. Tobias Keithforbes sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Felix Volta of the Hegemony (@esteban.volta).
Henrik "Ghost" Keithforbes put a child's drawing of a horse beside the bunk. Someone who had known Tobias Keithforbes helped clear the shelf without saying why.

A bullet hit Henrik "Ghost" Keithforbes's belt buckle at Q-F2 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Felix Volta of the Hegemony (@esteban.volta). Henrik "Ghost" Keithforbes had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Bram "Mud" Freaking crossed it, Henrik "Ghost" Keithforbes fired. Bram "Mud" Freaking was grazed.
Henrik "Ghost" Keithforbes no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A round went through Henrik "Ghost" Keithforbes's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Edmund Combs of the Hegemony (@victor__combs).
Henrik returned to Q-F2 limping a little. The squad pretended not to notice, and gave him the dry spot.
polipoart: Severin Polipoart arrived at R-S14 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
A newspaper reached Severin Polipoart with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Severin Polipoart let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Severin Polipoart splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Severin Polipoart is number 528. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Severin Polipoart did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Severin Polipoart fell asleep on watch. Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile took over without waking Severin, and told the sergeant nothing.
The telephone went dead during the shelling. Severin Polipoart watched the runner leave with the written orders, then listened for the phone to ring again.

Severin Polipoart was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S14. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Henrik Sleepyman of the Concord (@sleepyman_191).
Severin Polipoart's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Severin Polipoart found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: two small boys on a bench, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Severin Polipoart stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.
Severin carried Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins's pack for half a mile and never said a word. Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins noticed.
rhodehessner: The old hands of S-R18 have been here since Day 1. Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-R18 and grazed Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Yann Rattamus of the Concord (@rattamus2_1). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Back on the fire step at S-R18. Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
Bram Wade and Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner both swear they saw a ghost at the Ossuary Wood. Each says the other screamed first.
Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner lent Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.

Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Otto Mihai was badly wounded. Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Oskar Devonshireto was badly wounded.
The whole squad at S-R18 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Hugo's bullet that found Henrik Lakam, grazed.
